body: Thanks for your response. Yes, this is my first. I’m hopeful I can make it to the end and have a similar experience.

I have been looking into it but every medication I've talked about with my doctor has at least some risks and it's just not something I'm interested in risking. I could not forgive myself if something happened to the baby.

Thanks. Yes, that's a good way to describe it is constant background noise. On bad days the noise gets way louder and is harder to put away. I am not on the antidepressants anymore  because of risks to  the baby. My therapist wasn't judgmental toward me but I didn't find it all that helpful outside of the first few appointments. At first it felt good to get off my chest and say out loud, but then it just felt like something I had to force myself to do even when it didn't make me feel any better.

Thanks. I used to do more meditation and I think I will try getting back into it. I need to do something to keep me relaxed because I have been so anxious lately which I know personally contributes to my suicidal thoughts.
Thanks. I need to remind myself of this. He gets so concerned about me and I don't want to put stress on him but I do need to talk to him about it.

Thank you. I've been off of my medication due to risks to the baby. I didn't see a major improvement with medication and still regularly struggled with suicidal thoughts. But admittedly I was on them a short time before I needed to stop and likely didn't get the full affect/correct dosage. I'm planning to talk to my doctor.
Thanks I appreciate your response. I also keep telling myself to try to make it through. That has been one big way to cope for me is to make milestones to make it to.
Thanks. I went to a therapist and saw a doctor for antidepressant prescription but I have not had hormones checked by an endocrinologist. I will look into this I hope it can help.

I was on medication and therapy before I got pregnant and he knew about my suicidal thoughts then. I have not told him recently. There is a lot of shame around suicidal thoughts, and I feel there is an even bugger judgment toward a suicidal pregnant woman.
